title.zh: 选材原则：先问它负责什么
title.en: Material selection: identify the job first

subtitle.zh: Low-k 与 High-k 不是对手，而是不同岗位
subtitle.en: Low-k and High-k serve different functions

body.zh: 核心结论：功能 → 结构 → 指标 → 可靠性，再决定 k 高或低
body.en: Key point: function → structure → metrics → reliability, then choose k

body.zh: 这个电容是寄生还是功能？
body.en: Is the capacitance parasitic or functional?

body.zh: 量测反馈：Material → Test Structure → Device Electrical → Reliability → Product
body.en: Measurement loop: material → test structure → device electrical → reliability → product

body.zh: 边界提醒：封装语境中的 High-k 有时指高热导率，不一定是高介电常数
body.en: Boundary: in packaging, High-k can mean high thermal conductivity rather than dielectric constant

body.zh: 不是 k 越高或越低越好，而是功能匹配
body.en: The goal is functional fit, not the highest or lowest k
